about.title: About
about.intro: Originally from Bayonne, I'm now based in Bordeaux pursuing my Master's in Software Development at Ynov, alongside my apprenticeship at Uncove.

uncove.description: ArangoDB administration in prod, Node.js microservices, GitLab CI/CD pipelines, fraud detection systems, React front-end maintenance.

drivn.description: Development and maintenance of a dashboard interface powered by generative AI.

paries.description: Sales and customer service, stock management.

civique.title: Civic Service
civique.description: Gas safety prevention, eco-friendly practices awareness.

items.title: Rock-Paper-Scissors Microservice
items.description: A distributed microservices architecture built in Java implementing the classic game. Includes service discovery, load balancing, and inter-service communication via Spring Boot. Demonstrates enterprise-level design patterns and scalable system architecture.

items.title: My Old Grimoire
items.description: A full-stack book rating platform with user authentication, CRUD operations and image upload. Node.js/Express backend with MongoDB for data persistence. Implements secure authentication flows and optimized image management.

items.title: Mail Service
items.description: A lightweight microservice written in Go to handle email sending via SMTP. Exposes a REST API with a send endpoint and health check. Used in production for this portfolio's contact form. Designed to be containerized and easily deployable.

items.title: Library App
items.description: A mobile library management application built with React Native and Expo. Includes a dedicated backend with a CI/CD pipeline via GitHub Actions for automated testing and deployment to a remote server via SSH and Docker.

items.title: BiblioFlow
items.description: A fullstack application with frontend, backend and database, fully containerized with Docker Compose. Includes Nginx as a reverse proxy and separate environments for development and CI. Architecture designed for scalability and automated deployment.

items.title: Portfolio 2025
items.shortDescription: This portfolio, self-hosted on personal server
items.description: My current portfolio built with Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS v4 and Framer Motion. Bilingual FR/EN with next-intl, deployed via Docker on a self-hosted server accessible through Cloudflare Tunnel. Auto-deploys via GitHub Actions on every push to main.
